name: Giro del Veneto
story: The Giro del Veneto 2026 began with a crash-induced split leading to an early break of 8 riders. UAE Team Emirates - XRG controlled the peloton and caught the breakaway. Multiple attacks occurred in the final laps, but all were reeled in. Alessandro Covi won, followed by Anthon Charmig and Benoît Cosnefroy.
